that the table-to-be-removed is still referenced by transactions being
processed by the worker
column2: so we need to flush unconditionally.

column1: We could make the flush_work depend on whether we found a table to delete
in nf-next to avoid the flush for most cases.
AFAICS this problem is only exposed in nf-next
